## Standing operator rules:
- Run “Monthly payroll run 2025-03” steps in order, one at a time.
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if they share a release train.
- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Never edit `grafana/ledgerly-billing-v3.json` without first posting the proposed dashboard change in `#obs-dashboard` for `@mina` to review.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Stop the tenacity refactor; revisit it next sprint.

## Current objective:
Fix the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`, which is double-counting refunds. The payroll run is paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections:
- Payments API: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is superseded and shut down.
- Payroll: `payroll-2025-03`, period `2025-03`, version `3`, batch `batch-20250328-1842`, control total `986442.17`, approver `finance.ops`, funding `operating-usd`.
- Reconciliation source: `src/ledgerly/scheduler/recurrence.py` was inspected for a separate DST scheduling failure.

## Ruled-out approaches:
- Disabling idempotency middleware to stop 409s: caused duplicate invoices in staging Tuesday.

## Plan and progress:
- [done] Located recurrence calculation and serialization helpers.
- [in progress] Investigate refund aggregation in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`.
- [pending] Run `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`.
- [pending] Add a regression test, implement the minimal fix, and paste exact test output.
